siteName: Yungay Station, Atacama Desert, Chile (NASADEM_HGT V001)

provenance.datasetName: NASADEM Merged DEM Global 1 arc second V001 (NASADEM_HGT)
provenance.instrumentOrMission: Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM) + ASTER GDEM v3 + ICESat GLAS reprocessed
provenance.processingPerformed: Extracted 1 arc-second window via HTTP Range read from NASADEM_HGT_s25w070.tif and bilinearly resampled onto 30.0 m EPSG:32719 UTM Zone 19S grid.
provenance.resamplingMethod: Bilinear interpolation onto 30.0 m metric grid
provenance.limitations: C-band radar interferometry (~30 m horizontal resolution) resolves basin and ridge morphology but smooths sub-meter boulders.
